PROP-api-request-post-002.text: After nickname update, success=true implies the new nickname was persisted to Discord.
PROP-api-request-post-002.assertion: forall nicknameResp: nicknameResp.success == true => discord.getMember(uid).nickname == nicknameResp.updated_nickname

locations.note: Fire-and-forget: logs success/failure but does not verify persistence; callers do not check returned status
